{{Top|leg}}
'''Glowers''' were microscopic [[Algae/Legends|algae]] native to the deeper cloud layers of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. They were phosphorescent, giving the clouds a purple light. They were harvested for their use in [[Glower Make-Up|cosmetics]].

*''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]''
